resources.string: This phone is protected from intrusive ads.
Press the green button to turn protection on.
To protect the phone, please allow the connection in the dialog that appears. Try again.

How does it work?

• The app blocks ads inside games and other apps on this phone.
• It also protects against scam and phishing websites.
• When protection is on, a small key symbol appears at the top of the screen.
• Protection turns itself back on after the phone restarts.

Nothing else needs to be done. If an app misbehaves, press the red button to pause protection for a while.
Ads and dangerous websites are being blocked.
The rating tells you how dangerous a site is. All of them were stopped before they could load.
Nothing has been blocked yet.\n\nThe list fills in by itself while protection is on and you use the phone.
